nodes.question: Why are engineers and researchers concerned with the mixing behaviors and temperature fluctuations in T-sections?
nodes.answer: They are concerned because these fluctuations can cause thermal fatigue and damage.
nodes.paragraph: As previously stated, engineers and researchers are becoming increasingly concerned with the mixing behaviours and temperature uctuations in the T-section because they can cause thermal fatigue and damage.
